releases.name: AI Token League 0.7.20
releases.body:
AI Token League 0.7.20

Release date: 2026-11-01

## English

### Added

- [Desktop, Web] `magpie_local` source display support: colors, labels and ordering across the desktop app, public board and admin console; fed by the new Magpie plugin `magpie-atl-sync` (npm channel, one-line install via `magpie plugin add magpie-atl-sync`) — Magpie users can sync all usage their gateway collects (unified caliber) to the league without keeping the ATL desktop client running. See `magpie-plugin/README.md`.

### Performance

- [Desktop] Trigger convergence, per-entry query caching and VPN-reconnect self-healing: noticeably faster scans and view switching, tray data held in memory, incremental ledger merging (dirty-scope rewrites + zcode request-hash deltas), and runtime-log trimming reduced to once a day.

---

## 简体中文

### Added

- [Desktop, Web] 新来源 `magpie_local` 展示支持：桌面端、公开榜单与后台的配色、标签与排序就位；由新发布的 Magpie 插件 `magpie-atl-sync`（npm 渠道，`magpie plugin add magpie-atl-sync` 一行安装）上报——Magpie 用户可将其网关采集的全部用量（统一口径）同步上榜，替代常开 ATL 客户端，详见 `magpie-plugin/README.md`。

### Performance

- [Desktop] 触发收敛、逐条目查询缓存与 VPN 断连自愈：扫描与界面切换显著提速，托盘数据内存化，账本增量合并（脏 scope 重写 + zcode 请求级哈希增量），运行日志修剪改为每日一次。

---

### Artifacts / 发布产物

- Desktop installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- Signed Tauri updater packages and merged `latest.json` for in-app updates.
- macOS、Windows 和 Linux 桌面安装包。
- 已签名的 Tauri 更新包，以及用于应用内更新的合并版 `latest.json`。

releases.name: AI Token League 0.7.14
releases.body:
AI Token League 0.7.14

Release date: 2026-08-28

## English

### Added

- [Web] The public web now ranks usage by source dimension: a source top-3 module on the home page, per-source filtering on the leaderboard, and a source stats tab in the admin console, backed by new server-side source stats and source-filtered ranking APIs; the download page's source list follows the same dimension.

### Fixed

- [Desktop] Restored Cursor usage collection after cursor.com's Vercel Security Checkpoint started rejecting the rustls TLS fingerprint with 403 challenges: the collector now uses the platform-native TLS stack (SecureTransport on macOS, schannel on Windows, OpenSSL on Linux), verified on real Windows and macOS machines. Reconnecting an account on an older client cannot recover from this — upgrading to this version is required.
- [Desktop] Cursor auth failures are no longer silent: 30x login redirects and 401/403 responses are classified as auth errors, so token refresh runs and exhausted accounts visibly flip to "reconnect required" instead of staying active with zero rows; exported diagnostics now include the last scan's partial flag, failed provider ids, and per-provider errors.
- [Desktop] A provider that previously reported rows but returns none on a scan without an error keeps its previous local rows instead of being silently wiped, and full reconciliation never prunes a server-side scope whose provider failed its last scan — upstream outages can no longer destroy local or server history.
- [Desktop] Cursor account handling hardened: the session cookie is built from the canonical WorkOS user id embedded in the token, the Sources screen shows the account's last activity day derived from the raw event stream (visible even when recent usage is all Pro-included with no token rows), older records with a missing email are repaired opportunistically, and the account hash is never shown as a label.
- [Desktop] WorkBuddy workdir attribution stays stable when WorkBuddy reuses pid directories: attribution snapshots refresh per scan instead of pinning a stale cwd, so rescanned old traces keep landing in the correct working directory.

---

## 简体中文

### 新增

- [Web] 公榜新增来源维度：首页来源 Top3 模块、榜单按来源筛选、管理端来源统计标签页，由新增的服务端来源统计与来源维度排名接口支撑；下载页来源清单同步对齐来源维度。

### 修复

- [Desktop] 修复 Cursor 用量断流：cursor.com 的 Vercel 安全检查点开始按 TLS 指纹拦截 rustls（403 挑战页），采集器已切换到系统原生 TLS 栈（macOS SecureTransport / Windows schannel / Linux OpenSSL），Windows 与 macOS 真机均验证通过。旧客户端重连账号无法恢复，必须升级到本版本。
- [Desktop] Cursor 鉴权失败不再静默：30x 登录重定向与 401/403 统一按鉴权错误处理，触发 token 刷新，刷新无效的账号可见地翻为"需要重连"，不再停留 active 却零行；诊断导出新增上次扫描的 partial 标记、失败来源列表与逐来源错误。
- [Desktop] 上次有数据、本次零行且无报错的来源保留原有本地数据，不再被静默清空；全量对账不再 prune 上次扫描失败的来源的服务端数据——上游故障不会再破坏本地或服务器历史。
- [Desktop] Cursor 账号处理加固：会话 cookie 改用 token 内嵌的规范 WorkOS 用户 id 构造；来源页显示账号最后活跃日（从原始事件流推导，近期全是 Pro included 零 token 用量也可见）；历史缺失 email 的账号机会性修复；账号哈希不再作为界面标签展示。
- [Desktop] WorkBuddy 工作目录归因在 pid 目录复用场景下保持稳定：归因快照按扫描刷新，不再固化过期 cwd，重扫旧 trace 仍落到正确的工作目录。

---

### Artifacts / 发布产物

- Desktop installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- Signed Tauri updater packages and merged `latest.json` for in-app updates.
- macOS、Windows 和 Linux 桌面安装包。
- 已签名的 Tauri 更新包，以及用于应用内更新的合并版 `latest.json`。

AI Token League 0.7.13

Release date: 2026-08-24

## English

### Added

- [Desktop] Added Kimi as a supported local usage source: scans the Kimi desktop client's local agent sessions (daimon kernel `wire.jsonl` logs) with per-call token accounting (input, output, cache read/write) attributed to working directories, plus background title-generation usage; local Kimi usage verification is part of `npm run verify:ccusage`.
- [Web] Estimated cost now shows a unit-price line (price per 100M tokens) alongside the cost amount on the leaderboard medal cards, meter rows, list view, and the admin usage ranking.

---

## 简体中文

### 新增

- [Desktop] 新增 Kimi 本地用量来源：扫描 Kimi 桌面客户端的本地 Agent 会话（daimon 内核 `wire.jsonl` 日志），按次统计 token（输入、输出、缓存读写）并归属到工作目录，同时计入后台标题生成用量；本地 Kimi 用量校验已并入 `npm run verify:ccusage`。
- [Web] 预估费用旁新增单价指标（每 100M token 价格），覆盖榜单前三奖牌卡、占比行、列表视图与管理端用量排名。

---

- Desktop installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

- macOS、Windows 和 Linux 桌面安装包。
- 已签名的 Tauri 更新包，以及用于应用内更新的合并版 `latest.json`。

releases.name: AI Token League 0.7.4
releases.body:
AI Token League 0.7.4

Release date: 2026-05-29

## English

### Added

- [Web] Added the Community Intelligence analytics page with hourly activity trends, model/provider breakdowns, and embeddable public widgets.
- [Web] Added admin CSV export for usage daily data, with streaming output optimized for large datasets.

### Changed

- [Web] Redesigned the public download and community intelligence pages for clearer release, installer, and usage insight presentation.
- [Desktop] macOS DMGs now include a visible "已损坏修复" helper and Finder layout to guide users through quarantine repair after dragging the app into Applications.

### Fixed

- [Desktop] Config saves now use crash-resilient writes plus `.bak` recovery so interrupted Windows restarts do not recreate identity or show onboarding again.
- [Desktop, Web] Self-service cloud reset is now device-aware: a multi-device participant clears only the requesting device, while single-device participants still remove all cloud data.

---

## 简体中文

### 新增

- [Web] 新增 Community Intelligence 分析页，展示小时级活跃趋势、模型/Provider 分布和可嵌入公开组件。
- [Web] 新增 admin usage daily CSV 导出，并针对大数据量采用流式输出优化。

### 变更

- [Web] 重设计公开下载页和 Community Intelligence 页面，使 release、安装包和用量洞察信息更清晰。
- [Desktop] macOS DMG 现在包含可见的“已损坏修复”工具和 Finder 布局，引导用户拖入“应用程序”后修复 quarantine 隔离属性。

### 修复

- [Desktop] 配置保存改为抗崩溃写入并提供 `.bak` 恢复，避免 Windows 重启中断后重建身份或重新出现 onboarding。
- [Desktop, Web] 自助云端重置改为按设备处理：多设备参与者只清理当前请求设备，单设备参与者仍清理全部云端数据。

---

### Artifacts / 发布产物

- Desktop installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- Signed Tauri updater packages and merged `latest.json` for in-app updates.
- macOS、Windows 和 Linux 桌面安装包。
- 已签名的 Tauri 更新包，以及用于应用内更新的合并版 `latest.json`。
